action_or_input: Employee opens file-creation function, enters a valid initial comment, and saves as draft (no attachment).
expected_result: A draft file is created with the initial comment preserved; creation and audit information is recorded; no circulated file is created.
preconditions: Employee is authenticated, has an assigned role context, and is authorized to create files.
purpose: Verify that an authorized employee can create a new file with a mandatory comment and save it as a draft.

action_or_input: Employee opens file-creation function, enters a valid initial comment, adds one or more attachments, and saves as draft.
expected_result: A draft file is created with the initial comment and attachments preserved; creation, comment, and attachment audit information is recorded.
preconditions: Employee is authenticated, has an assigned role context, and is authorized to create files.
purpose: Verify that an authorized employee can create a new file with a mandatory comment and optional attachments, saving as a draft.
source_id: FTS-UC-001 Main Success Scenario with attachment

action_or_input: Employee opens file-creation function, enters a valid initial comment, and chooses immediate circulation (triggering FTS-UC-003 flow) rather than saving as draft.
expected_result: The file transitions to circulation (FTS-UC-003 flow is invoked); no draft is retained beyond the initial creation.
preconditions: Employee is authenticated, has an assigned role context, is authorized to create files, and a valid recipient exists.
purpose: Verify that a valid created file can proceed immediately to circulation via FTS-UC-003 instead of remaining as a draft.

action_or_input: Employee opens file-creation function, enters a valid initial comment, provides no attachment, and saves as draft.
expected_result: Draft file is created successfully without any attachment; audit information is recorded.
preconditions: Employee is authenticated, has an assigned role context, and is authorized to create files.
purpose: Verify that file creation proceeds successfully when no attachment is supplied, since attachments are optional.

action_or_input: Employee opens file-creation function, leaves the comment field empty, and attempts to save.
expected_result: FTS does not accept or persist the file; an appropriate validation error is returned; no file record is created.
preconditions: Employee is authenticated, has an assigned role context, and is authorized to create files.
purpose: Verify that FTS rejects file creation/save when the initial mandatory comment is missing.

action_or_input: Employee attempts to open the file-creation function and create a file.
expected_result: FTS denies the action; no file is created.
preconditions: Employee is authenticated but has a role that does not permit file creation.
purpose: Verify that FTS denies file creation when the selected role is not authorized to create files.

action_or_input: Employee opens the authorized draft, modifies the comment and/or attachments, and saves.
expected_result: Draft is updated and retained with the new content; applicable audit/version information is recorded.
preconditions: A draft file exists and the employee is authorized to edit it.
purpose: Verify that an authorized employee can open a draft file, edit its comment and/or attachments, and save the updated draft.

action_or_input: Employee opens the authorized draft and chooses Discard instead of Save.
expected_result: The draft file is removed from FTS; no circulated file is created.
preconditions: A draft file exists (not yet submitted/circulated) and the employee is authorized to edit/discard it.
purpose: Verify that an authorized employee can discard a draft file before it is submitted/circulated.

action_or_input: Employee attempts to discard the already-circulated file.
expected_result: FTS denies the discard action; the circulated file remains unchanged.
preconditions: A file exists that has already been submitted and circulated.
purpose: Verify that FTS does not permit discarding a file that has already been submitted/circulated.

action_or_input: An unauthorized employee attempts to open and edit or discard the draft.
expected_result: FTS denies access/action; the draft remains unchanged.
preconditions: A draft file exists belonging to another employee.
purpose: Verify that FTS denies access or edit/discard action on a draft when the employee is not authorized for it.

action_or_input: Sender opens the actionable file, selects a valid recipient, enters a mandatory movement comment, and confirms Send/Forward.
expected_result: File is forwarded to the recipient; sender, receiver, timestamp, movement comment are recorded chronologically; audit/version information is updated; file-forwarded/file-received notification events are triggered.
preconditions: An active, non-archived file exists; sender is authorized to act on it; a valid recipient employee exists.
purpose: Verify that an authorized sender can forward an active file to a valid recipient with a mandatory movement comment.

action_or_input: Sender opens the actionable file, selects a valid recipient, enters a mandatory movement comment, adds one or more attachments, and confirms Send/Forward.
expected_result: File is forwarded; movement details including attachments are recorded chronologically; notification events are triggered.
preconditions: An active, non-archived file exists; sender is authorized; a valid recipient employee exists.
purpose: Verify that forwarding proceeds with optional attachments included at the movement stage.
source_id: FTS-UC-003 Main Success Scenario with attachment

action_or_input: Current recipient opens the received file, selects a new recipient, enters a mandatory movement comment, and confirms Send/Forward.
expected_result: File is forwarded onward; movement history records the new sender (prior recipient), new receiver, timestamp, and comment; notification events are triggered.
preconditions: An active file has been received by an employee; that employee is authorized to forward it.
purpose: Verify that a recipient of an earlier movement can use the same Send/Forward goal to forward the file onward to another employee.
source_id: FTS-UC-003 Alternative Flow 1 (onward forwarding by recipient)

action_or_input: Sender forwards the file with a mandatory movement comment and no attachment.
expected_result: File is forwarded successfully; movement is recorded; notification events are triggered.
preconditions: An active, non-archived file exists; sender is authorized; a valid recipient exists.
purpose: Verify that forwarding proceeds successfully when no attachment is supplied, since attachments are optional.

action_or_input: Sender selects a valid recipient, leaves the movement comment empty, and attempts to confirm Send/Forward.
expected_result: FTS blocks the forwarding action; no movement is recorded; file state remains unchanged.
preconditions: An active, non-archived file exists; sender is authorized; a valid recipient exists.
purpose: Verify that forwarding is blocked when the mandatory movement comment is missing.
source_id: FTS-UC-003 Exception Flow 1 (missing mandatory movement comment)

action_or_input: Sender enters a mandatory movement comment but selects or provides an invalid/non-existent recipient, then confirms Send/Forward.
expected_result: FTS blocks the forwarding action; no movement is recorded; file state remains unchanged.
preconditions: An active, non-archived file exists; sender is authorized.
purpose: Verify that forwarding is blocked when an invalid recipient is specified.

action_or_input: Unauthorized employee enters a movement comment, selects a valid recipient, and attempts Send/Forward.
expected_result: FTS blocks the forwarding action; file state is unchanged.
preconditions: An active, non-archived file exists; a user without authorization for this file attempts to forward it.
purpose: Verify that forwarding is blocked when the sender is not authorized to act on the file.

action_or_input: Employee attempts to forward an archived file with a valid recipient and mandatory comment.
expected_result: FTS blocks the forwarding action; file state remains archived and unchanged.
preconditions: A file exists in Archived state; sender is otherwise authorized.
purpose: Verify that forwarding is blocked when the file is archived.

action_or_input: Recipient opens the received file, selects Return, enters a mandatory movement comment, and confirms Return.
expected_result: File is returned to the previous sender; return movement is recorded chronologically with movement details; current holder is updated to the previous sender; audit/version information is updated; file-returned notification event is triggered.
preconditions: File is active, associated with the recipient, has a known sender for the current movement, and recipient is authorized to return it.
purpose: Verify that an authorized recipient can return an active received file to its sender with a mandatory movement comment.

action_or_input: Recipient selects Return, enters a mandatory movement comment, provides no attachment, and confirms Return.
expected_result: File is returned successfully; movement is recorded; notification event is triggered.
preconditions: File is active, associated with the recipient, has a known sender, and recipient is authorized to return.
purpose: Verify that return proceeds successfully when no attachment is supplied, since attachments are optional.
source_id: FTS-UC-004 Alternative Flow 1 (no attachment on return)

action_or_input: Recipient selects Return, enters a mandatory movement comment, adds one or more attachments, and confirms Return.
expected_result: File is returned; movement details including attachments are recorded chronologically; notification event is triggered.
preconditions: File is active, associated with the recipient, has a known sender, and recipient is authorized to return.
purpose: Verify that return proceeds with optional attachments included at the return movement stage.
source_id: FTS-UC-004 Main Success Scenario with attachment

action_or_input: Recipient selects Return, leaves the movement comment empty, and attempts to confirm Return.
expected_result: FTS blocks the return action; no movement is recorded; file state remains unchanged.
preconditions: File is active and associated with the recipient who is authorized to return it.
purpose: Verify that return is blocked when the mandatory movement comment is missing.
source_id: FTS-UC-004 Exception Flow 1 (missing mandatory movement comment on return)

action_or_input: Unauthorized employee attempts to return the file with a mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: FTS blocks the return action; file state remains unchanged.
preconditions: File is active; an employee not associated/authorized for this file attempts to return it.
purpose: Verify that return is blocked when the employee is not authorized to return the file.
source_id: FTS-UC-004 Exception Flow 2 (unauthorized action on return)

action_or_input: Employee attempts to return an archived file with a mandatory movement comment.
expected_result: FTS blocks the return action; file state remains archived and unchanged.
preconditions: File is in Archived state; employee would otherwise be an authorized recipient.
purpose: Verify that return is blocked when the file is in an archived/completed state.
source_id: FTS-UC-004 Exception Flow 2 (archived file return blocked)

action_or_input: Employee opens the Inbox.
expected_result: FTS lists files received by the employee subject to authorization; employee can select and open an authorized file, which displays its contents, comments, attachments, status, and permitted actions.
preconditions: Employee is authenticated in an FTS role context; at least one file has been received by the employee.
purpose: Verify that an authenticated employee can open the Inbox and see files received by them.

action_or_input: Employee opens the Outbox.
expected_result: FTS lists files sent by the employee subject to authorization; employee can select and open an authorized file, which displays its contents, comments, attachments, status, and permitted actions.
preconditions: Employee is authenticated in an FTS role context; at least one file has been sent by the employee.
purpose: Verify that an authenticated employee can open the Outbox and see files sent by them.

action_or_input: Employee opens Inbox or Outbox and selects an archived file.
expected_result: FTS displays the archived file in read-only mode; no modification or forwarding actions are available.
preconditions: Employee is authenticated; an archived file associated with the employee exists.
purpose: Verify that an archived file is presented as readable/read-only when accessed from Inbox or Outbox.

action_or_input: Employee attempts to access a file they are not authorized to view (e.g., by direct file ID).
expected_result: FTS does not expose or open the file; no unauthorized file content is revealed.
preconditions: Employee is authenticated; a file exists that the employee has no association/authorization to view.
purpose: Verify that FTS does not expose or open a file the employee is not authorized to view.
source_id: FTS-UC-005 Exception Flow 1 (unauthorized file not exposed)

action_or_input: Employee opens an authorized file and attempts an action not permitted by current role/state.
expected_result: The unauthorized action is unavailable or denied by FTS; file state is unchanged.
preconditions: Employee is authenticated; a file exists in a state or role context that does not permit a specific action (e.g., forwarding on an archived file).
purpose: Verify that actions not authorized for the current file state/role are unavailable or denied.

action_or_input: Employee selects the associated file and requests its tracking history.
expected_result: FTS retrieves and displays chronological history from creation onward, including movement events with sender, receiver, timestamp, movement comments, and movement attachments.
preconditions: File exists and employee is authorized/associated with it.
purpose: Verify that an authorized associated employee can view the complete chronological tracking history of a file.

action_or_input: Employee requests tracking history for that file.
expected_result: FTS displays history records covering creation, forwarding, return, and archival events chronologically.
preconditions: A file exists that has gone through creation, forward, return, and archival events; employee is authorized/associated with it.
purpose: Verify that the tracking history includes creation, forward, return, and archival-related audit/version records as maintained by FTS.
source_id: FTS-UC-006 Alternative Flow 1 (history includes all event types)

action_or_input: Unauthorized employee requests tracking history for the file.
expected_result: FTS denies history access; no history content is disclosed; stored history remains unchanged.
preconditions: A file exists; an employee with no association/authorization to the file attempts to view its history.
purpose: Verify that FTS denies tracking history access to an employee not authorized/associated with the file.
source_id: FTS-UC-006 Exception Flow 1 (unauthorized history access denied)

action_or_input: File owner opens the active circulated file, selects Archive, and confirms.
expected_result: FTS verifies ownership; file transitions to Archived/Read-only state; subsequent modification and forwarding are prevented; authorized users retain permanent readable access; archival audit/version event is recorded; file-archived notification event is triggered.
preconditions: File has been circulated, is not already archived, and the acting employee is the file owner.
purpose: Verify that the file owner can archive a completed circulated file, transitioning it to Archived/Read-only state.

action_or_input: File owner attempts to archive an already-archived file.
expected_result: FTS presents the existing read-only/archived state; no new archival transition or duplicate audit event is performed.
preconditions: File is already in Archived state; employee is the file owner.
purpose: Verify that if a file is already archived, FTS presents the existing read-only state and performs no new archival transition.

action_or_input: Non-owner employee attempts to archive the file.
expected_result: FTS denies the archival action; file remains in its prior active state; no archival event is recorded.
preconditions: File is active and circulated; employee is not the file owner.
purpose: Verify that a non-owner archival attempt is denied by FTS.

action_or_input: Employee without required authorization attempts to archive the file.
expected_result: FTS denies the archival action; file remains active and unchanged; no archival event is recorded.
preconditions: File is active; employee claiming ownership lacks required authorization.
purpose: Verify that archival is denied when required authorization is absent.

action_or_input: Employee selects an assigned role context through the Fusion dashboard and uses FTS functions under that role.
expected_result: FTS applies the selected role context to determine permitted access/actions; existing file ownership and previously recorded audit history are preserved across the role switch.
preconditions: Employee has at least two assigned roles; role switching is available.
purpose: Verify that an employee with multiple assigned roles can select a role context and use FTS under that role, with existing file ownership and audit history preserved.

action_or_input: Employee uses FTS without switching role context.
expected_result: FTS automatically applies the single assigned role context; no role-switch action is required; FTS functions are available per that role.
preconditions: Employee has exactly one assigned role.
purpose: Verify that if an employee has only one applicable role, FTS uses that role context without requiring a switch.

action_or_input: Employee attempts to perform a sensitive FTS action not permitted under the currently selected role.
expected_result: FTS denies the requested action; no unauthorized FTS action is enabled; file/audit records remain unchanged.
preconditions: Employee has selected a role context that does not permit a specific sensitive FTS action.
purpose: Verify that FTS denies a sensitive action when the selected role does not authorize that action.
source_id: FTS-UC-008 Exception Flow 1 (role does not authorize action)

action_or_input: System Admin assigns or reassigns an FTS-relevant role to an Institute Employee.
expected_result: FTS consumes and records the resulting role/access context; a role assignment/reassignment notification event is triggered; operational file ownership and processing remain with Institute Employees.
preconditions: System Admin has applicable administrative privileges; a target Institute Employee exists.
purpose: Verify that a System Admin can assign or reassign FTS-relevant role/access context and that FTS records the resulting context and triggers a notification event.

action_or_input: System Admin opens FTS governance function and reviews usage/security/audit information.
expected_result: FTS presents available audit/usage/security information to the System Admin within governance scope; no operational file data is modified.
preconditions: System Admin has applicable administrative privileges; FTS audit/usage records exist.
purpose: Verify that a System Admin can review FTS usage/security/audit information within the available governance scope.

action_or_input: FTS is queried for the newly created user's identity context for FTS authorization purposes.
expected_result: FTS uses the identity/account context provided by the platform; FTS does not perform or own user-directory administration.
preconditions: A new user account has been created through Fusion/platform administration (outside FTS).
purpose: Verify that FTS consumes resulting identity/account context from platform administration rather than owning platform-wide user-directory administration.
source_id: FTS-UC-009 Alternative Flow 1 (basic user account creation is platform responsibility)

action_or_input: System Admin attempts to create, forward, return, comment on, or archive an operational file.
expected_result: FTS denies the operational file workflow action; existing file state remains unchanged.
preconditions: System Admin has administrative privileges but is not an Institute Employee file participant.
purpose: Verify that FTS denies any operational file workflow action attempted by the System Admin.
source_id: FTS-UC-009 Exception Flow 1 (System Admin operational file action denied)

action_or_input: Authorized consuming Fusion module calls an FTS API for file/workflow-tracking support.
expected_result: FTS validates integration authorization and RBAC context; performs the supported file/workflow-tracking service within FTS boundary; records applicable audit information; returns the service response to the consuming module.
preconditions: Integration is authorized; consuming module provides access/context required by FTS RBAC and audit rules.
purpose: Verify that an authorized consuming Fusion module can invoke an FTS API and receive a valid service response with audit information recorded.

action_or_input: Consuming Fusion module invokes an FTS API for approval-chain support and separately for file-based request tracking.
expected_result: FTS performs each supported service capability correctly; consuming module's own domain semantics are not modified by FTS; audit information is recorded for each integration action.
preconditions: Integration is authorized; consuming module provides required access/context.
purpose: Verify that a consuming module may use different FTS service capabilities (workflow support, approval-chain support, or file-based request tracking) while retaining its own domain semantics.
source_id: FTS-UC-010 Alternative Flow 1 (different FTS service capabilities)

action_or_input: Unauthorized module calls an FTS API without valid authorization credentials/context.
expected_result: FTS rejects the integration request; no FTS action is performed; no unauthorized data is exposed.
preconditions: A consuming module or external caller without valid authorization attempts to invoke an FTS API.
purpose: Verify that FTS rejects an unauthorized integration attempt.

action_or_input: Consuming module invokes an FTS API with a request that attempts to delegate domain-specific approval policy ownership to FTS.
expected_result: FTS rejects or ignores the out-of-scope policy definition request; FTS does not invent or own the consuming module's approval rules; consuming module retains responsibility for its own domain-specific approval policy.
preconditions: An authorized consuming Fusion module sends an API request asking FTS to define or own its domain-specific approval policy.
purpose: Verify that FTS does not define a consuming module's domain-specific approval policy when such a request is made via the API.
source_id: FTS-UC-010 Exception Flow 2 (domain-specific policy definition request rejected)
